title: §81 The word-matching allocation-cost case did not travel upstream with the matcher work
body:
**Preserved** ℹ: at submodule commit `eb0ac0ff2`, reachable in the submodule's history; restore locally with
`git -C app/src/main/cpp/libosmscout checkout eb0ac0ff2 -- the test file`. The fix is a focused upstream PR on top of
upstream's copy, so it has to be committed inside the submodule and followed by the gitlink bump.

title: §24 The sharp-s uppercase form is not folded
body:
**Known limitation** ℹ: the character map row for U+1E9E folds to itself. The row belongs in libosmscout,
where the table is regenerated, so the fix is a commit there rather than one this run can make.
